title: Design resources
description: Template libraries, UI kits and design references.

items.name: Oversight Supply
items.description: 192+ Webflow templates, Framer templates and reusable sections by Oversight Studio LLC. Previews are free.
items.verdictNote: free reference only; client work if a client wants Webflow
items.why: 192+ Webflow templates, Framer templates and reusable sections by Oversight Studio LLC. Previews are free.
items.cost: Membership: monthly credits or lifetime

blockers: Webflow templates only run inside Webflow; code export needs a PAID Webflow plan on top of the membership
Exported Webflow code is static - CMS and form handling do not travel with it
Framer export is more limited still
Our targets are self-contained artifact pages and Vercel; neither accepts a Webflow/Framer template
Net effect: pay Supply + pay Webflow + still rebuild for our stack, against a $100/mo total budget
useFor: Free design-direction reference before designing a page
Consulting client projects where the client specifically wants Webflow so they can self-edit

items.name: DESIGN.md format (Google) + designmd.ai
items.description: One markdown file per brand: YAML tokens (colours, type, radius, spacing) plus plain-English rationale that coding agents read. The CLI lints it (broken references, WCAG contrast), diffs versions, and exports to Tailwind v3/v4 or W3C tokens. This is the cleanest fix for 'every page you generate looks different': one DESIGN.md per venture.
items.verdictNote: adopt the FORMAT; use the website only for ideas
items.why: Format is alpha: the spec is under active development and may change designmd.ai is a community upload site: operator not named on the page, no licence stated, 'hundreds' of systems, no count; I could not confirm whether listed systems copy real brands (Stripe, Apple, etc.). Do not ship a look-alike of a real brand designmd.ai MCP needs a free API key for downloads (7 tools, about 2K tokens of context); not tested
items.cost: Format: free, Apache-2.0 (github.com/google-labs-code/design.md, 26.3k stars, v0.3.0 Jun 2026, alpha). designmd.ai: free, free API key to download

blockers: Format is alpha: the spec is under active development and may change

designmd.ai is a community upload site: operator not named on the page, no licence stated, 'hundreds' of systems, no count; I could not confirm whether listed systems copy real brands (Stripe, Apple, etc.). Do not ship a look-alike of a real brand
designmd.ai MCP needs a free API key for downloads (7 tools, about 2K tokens of context); not tested
useFor: One DESIGN.md each for finance-education content, indie web-game, consulting, content studio
Lint contrast before publishing any page or thumbnail template
Export tokens to Tailwind for the animated-page kit

items.name: shadcn/ui
items.description: The de facto standard component base; Aceternity, Magic UI, 21st.dev, Motion Primitives and UIAble are all built on or around it. The repo has a skills folder, but I did not read its contents, and I did not verify any MCP server.
items.verdictNote: adopt as the base for any real app UI (dashboards, Vercel sites); not for self-contained artifacts
items.why: Needs a project with a build step: it does not paste into a single-file artifact The claims about CLI, registry, MCP and skills come from the repo listing, not from docs I read
items.cost: Free, MIT (125k stars, source on GitHub)

blockers: Needs a project with a build step: it does not paste into a single-file artifact
The claims about CLI, registry, MCP and skills come from the repo listing, not from docs I read
useFor: finance-education dashboard and Whop-adjacent pages on Vercel
Sports analytics dashboard (Phase 5)

items.description: v4 modular build, 24.5 KB total: timeline, scroll-triggered animation, SVG line drawing, morphing and motion paths, draggable, WAAPI. items.why: Overlaps Motion and GSAP already adopted: pick ONE per page to keep size down I did not run it; the 4.0.0 version and size figures come from its site header

blockers: No stated review process: quality and accessibility vary widely, so check each element
